title: canon-authority/1
description: A list of `AuthorityDecision` entries. One entry of a `canon-authority/1` document: a capability, the scope the decision covers and the decision. A capability decided twice at an equal scope (the same keys with the same values, in any order) is refused, whatever the decision; the JSON Schema cannot express that, and refuses only an entry repeated exactly.

Identifier.description: A well-formed identifier is not empty, and without whitespace, control characters or Unicode format characters (general category Cf). The pattern checks only for whitespace; Canon also refuses control and Unicode format characters.

AuthorityDecision.description: One entry of a `canon-authority/1` document: a capability, the scope the decision covers and the decision.

capability.description: The capability decided, an identifier an action's `requires` may name.

scope.description: The scope the decision covers: one value for each key it names, each key once. It covers a requirement of its capability when the requirement gives each of those keys the same value; a key it leaves out covers every value of it. Absent or empty, it covers every scope.

Grant.description: An authority decision on one capability at one scope. Among the decisions covering a requirement, `denied` wins over `require_approval`, which wins over `granted`; none covering it is not granted. With its precondition `true`, an action is `admissible` when every requirement is granted, `blocked` when one is denied, and `approval-required` when none is denied and one requires approval or is not decided.
